TM15–23 retain strict wall-clock threshold, destructive early query and biased-repeat probabilities; IO16–20 preserve request-before-construct failure/catch boundaries and Ruby2.6-only historical execution.

world.assessment: DQ/CS/MR preserve temporary query construction, seed/placement prefix, exact Cut Scene gate, load clearing and guarded restoration. RM/SF/ER preserve original anchors, one random attempt, surviving surf base and the three distinct erase entrances; later precise fixes do not erase these premises or promote default Demo reachability.

creature.assessment: The five active PP items retain battle living-target rejection and field fainted-target recovery; the precise refund chain ends POTION2 under its original gates. IV01–04 retain two distinct Power items→3 inherited attributes versus Knot+at most one Power→5. IF01–06 retain threshold/forced/battle/storage/state-before-resource distinctions. WP66-A225 now supports the former B5 Summary residue only, with cancellation/resource failure preserving already committed display-read prefixes.

combat.assessment: NaturalGift first-hit JABO/ORAN consumption leaves U71 and empty current item; the next ordinary base lookup first fails before data lookup/default1/second HP commit. High-HP and single-hit controls remain distinct. The new diagnostic retry wrapper preserves this first failure and prefix instead of rewriting it as a universal process crash or clean normal return.

ui.assessment: Current independent shared-file review retains ordinary-image shiny=false versus stored true and multi-form selector first-write false, Area visible union versus WP63 first-point selection, shared quantity BACK>USE>direction versus shop direction>USE>BACK. A05/A06/A41 contain one separate current Party display-read/cancellation conflict; it is reported in the combination overlay, not projected onto all old R4/R3 criteria or old C125.

R4/JXN and current catalog gates keep all named material and execution qualifications; no new BMP or source-domain approval is claimed.
